title: Onboarding signal scramble — weekly research log (Mar 03 2026)
summary: Weekly capture from the onboarding spike focused on signal stability when rolling compact quantized variants for model onboarding. Main themes: regression triage for 4-bit GPTQ runs, eval-suite gaps for instruction-following prompts, and swapping in a lightweight prefetch + microbatch policy for KV-heavy workloads.
notes:
Context: we are onboarding two model families (small-ops-7B and converser-13B) for Redwood Dedicated test tenants. Goal this sprint: get a serving-safe quantized build (<= 4GiB per replica for 7B, <= 12GiB for 13B) with no >2% delta in our instr-follow eval set and acceptable latency under 95th percentile SLOs.

Experiment log (Mar 1–3):
- run-2026-03-01-gptq-4bit-7b: GPTQ quantization with per-channel weight groups (64) + outlier clipping. Eval (instr-follow-v2): exact-match delta +1.6% vs fp16 baseline (baseline EM 78.4%, quant 76.8%). Latency: median token latency 12.8ms (fp16 11.0ms). Memory per replica: 3.9GiB. Notes: small hallucination uptick on long-multi-turn prompts.
- run-2026-03-02-lsq-4bit-13b: LSQ quantization (symmetric) for converser-13B. Eval regression larger: EM delta +3.9% on instr-follow-v2; perplexity shift from 11.2 -> 12.1. Memory: 11.4GiB. Latency regressed ~8% vs fp16 for short sequences (due to int->fp dequant overhead).
- run-2026-03-03-kv-prefetch-microbatch: New microbatch policy (size 2) with KV prefetch for recency-heavy workloads. Observed 18% token-throughput improvement in synthetic chat bench with cached prefixes, and 12% reduction in 95th percentile latency for cached sessions. Interacts poorly with quantized 13B LSQ path (extra dequant hops amplified).

Eval gaps found: our instr-follow-v2 suite underweights multi-turn retrieval-style prompts and semantic entailment checks. New proposed probes: (1) multi-turn retrieval-long (50+ tokens prefix churn), (2) instruction-clarity test (contradictory edits). Added to backlog.

Triage notes: 4-bit GPTQ for 7B is within acceptable regression for most customers but needs a prompt-set gated rollout. Converser-13B LSQ path fails our internal bar: higher hallucinations and latency spikes in low-batch scenarios. Action: hold 13B LSQ from canary, evaluate alternative quantizers (GPTQ-4/8 hybrid, chunked-quant) and explore selective FP16 on attention-output layer.
